avisoMobile.texto: This 3D simulation was designed for desktop — there is more room for the equipment and instruments, and performance is better. You can still continue on your phone.

bemVindo.texto: The ambient sound you hear is the real noise of a substation in operation. Throughout the procedure, some sound effects will play and an instructor will guide you through each step as clearly as possible.

inbrat.vias: C1 and C2: red current leads. P1 and P2: black leads that measure voltage.
inbrat.garras: Each clamp takes two leads: P1/C1 or P2/C2. The clamp handle color identifies the cable in the scene; it does not indicate polarity.
inbrat.sentido: In the animations we use C1 → installation → C2. The manual does not explicitly identify the positive pole; this direction is a teaching convention.
